subject: Request: temporary capacity bump for launch — pricing & PO
messages:
From: Maya Rao <maya@trademarket.io>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 21 Apr 2026 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: temporary capacity bump for launch — pricing & PO

Hi Vivek,

Quick ask — we have a marketing-driven traffic spike scheduled for May 3–7 and expect ~3x our normal QPS for ~72 hours. Can Redwood temporarily bump our API quota/rate limit to support ~8k inference calls/min during that window? Our engineering team did a quick estimate and thinks that will translate to ~120M tokens across the five days.

We need to confirm pricing (pro-rata, overrun handling) and whether you require a PO. Procurement is asking for a short agreement or an invoice estimate before they process the PO.

Happy to hop on a short call if helpful — thanks for any fast guidance.

Best,
Maya Rao
Head of Product
TradeMarket

P.S. copying our procurement mailbox.

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Maya Rao <maya@trademarket.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 21 Apr 2026 10:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: temporary capacity bump for launch — pricing & PO

Hi Maya —

Thanks for the heads up and the numbers. We can support a temporary uplift; two operational paths we typically offer depending on preference:

1) Temporary quota elevation (fastest): increase rate limit to the requested /8k calls/min for May 3–7. Billing will be pro-rated for the uplift window at your current committed rate per token. For overrun (tokens beyond the uplift estimate), we can apply a one-time 10% discount on the overage rate. We require a PO or signed short SOW for authorization; I attached a one-page temporary-headroom-sow-v1.docx you can share with Procurement.

2) Burst credit + soft cap (preferred for predictable billing): we can grant a one-time burst credit that covers the first 80M of the excess tokens; any consumption beyond that is billed at standard overrun rates (no additional discount). This removes wage on reconfig and is quicker where Procurement prefers credit memos instead of contract changes.

Operational checklist I need from you to execute:
- Confirm selected option (1 or 2)
- Estimated exact start/end timestamps (UTC)
- PO number or signed SOW returned by EOD Apr 27 to hit approvals 

If it helps, Ben can run a quick cost simulation so Procurement has an invoice estimate for the PO.

Attaching: temporary-headroom-sow-v1.docx (one-page SOW template)

Regards,
Vivek Kulkarni
Senior Account Director, Redwood Inference
vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0123

---
Attachment: temporary-headroom-sow-v1.docx (1 page — temporary quota uplift template)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 21 Apr 2026 11:35:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Request: temporary capacity bump for launch — pricing & PO

Internal note — posting a quick alternative to consider before we lock in option 1 or 2.

Given TradeMarket's ARR and recent usage growth, I recommend we offer a hybrid:
- 50M token complimentary buffer for the May 3–7 window (applied as a one-time credit), AND
- If they need additional uplift beyond that, bill overrun at the committed rate with a 7% discount (better than the 10% Vivek proposed).

Rationale: a small free buffer keeps the launch low-friction and increases stickiness; the slightly better discount helps close the PO faster. We should cap the total financial exposure (our max credit + discounted overrun) and note that this is a one-time concession tied to this specific launch.

If you agree, I can prepare a redlined SOW and a short email for Procurement confirming the concession and the exact invoice estimate.

Ben
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai

---
(Internal: do not share the internal margin calc in the external email; provide only the final consumer-facing numbers.)

From: Procurement <procurement@trademarket.io>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Maya Rao <maya@trademarket.io>
Date: Wed, 22 Apr 2026 15:30:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Request: temporary capacity bump for launch — pricing & PO

Hi Vivek / Ben —

Thanks for the quick turnaround and the SOW. TradeMarket is happy to proceed with Ben's hybrid proposal: 50M token one-time credit + 7% discount on any overrun beyond that buffer for the May 3–7 uplift window. We confirm the uplift window as 2026-05-03T00:00:00Z to 2026-05-07T23:59:59Z (UTC).

I've attached our PO (TM-PO-0421.pdf). Please prepare a short amendment or confirmation email that we can attach to our PO stating the terms: the credit amount, the discounted overrun rate, and the invoice timing (bill after the uplift window with a final true-up). We also need a single point of contact for post-launch billing reconciliation.

If you can provide the amendment today, we will circulate the PO internally and issue it within 24 hours.

Thanks,
Procurement Team
TradeMarket

Attachment: TM-PO-0421.pdf (purchase order)
